english.title: Take photo / film etc for the purposes of a trade / employment etc within Parliament Square Garden without permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within the central garden of Parliament Square, other than when acting in accordance with permission given in writing by the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission,

(A)_[took photographs]_
(B)_[filmed]_
(C)_[made a recording of visual images]_
(D)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..)]_

for the purposes of or in connection with a business, trade, profession or employment or activity carried out by a person or body of persons, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS ETC..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1)(k) of the Parliament Square Garden Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3) of the Greater London Authority Act 1999.

english.notes: (i) See byelaw 9 where a person must, on demand, provide their name and address should an authorised person have reasonable ground to believe a person has contravened the byelaws.
